title: Versions protect callers
summary: A new contract version gives callers time to move. A safe added optional field is often easier than removing a field callers still need.
introduction: A new contract version gives callers time to move. A safe added optional field is often easier than removing a field callers still need. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A new contract version gives callers time to move. A safe added optional field is often easier than removing a field callers still need.
A caller that ignores unknown fields can keep using id and title. Removing title would break it.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Describe how to retire a field only after callers stop using it.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Adding a field can still break strict callers; check their contracts.
For more detail later, use this [Microservices further reading](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/microservices/).
